findings.issue: «sobre todo» is the ordinary Spanish idiom «especially», so עַל plus כָּל («upon» + «all») can be read as one adverb instead of a preposition over all of the frankincense.

notes: Remaining clauses match the tokens: hiphil 3ms, the priest, her memorial, from her crushed grain and from her oil, frankincense, fire-offering, to Jehová.
